description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahengama, Kuruvita D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620274
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and details, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and property registration, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
